issues.description: Symbol `display_start` is required as the base address of the framebuffer (problem statement) and is allocated in the template (`display_start RESB 8294400`). In the solution, the allocation of `display_start` is removed/replaced by a comment, but the code in both `set_pixel` and `main` still references `display_start` as a symbol. This makes the solution inconsistent with the template/problem statement and can lead to an undefined symbol / non-compiling reference if `display_start` is not actually defined.
issues.suggestedFix: Define `display_start` in the solution the same way as in the template (`section .bss` with `display_start RESB 8294400`) and remove the misleading comment, or (if stack/allocation change is intended) update both solution and template/problem statement to pass the base address explicitly and eliminate all direct references to the `display_start` symbol.
